mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = #{classId}) as totalStudents, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hs.student_id) FROM teacher_homework_submission hs JOIN student_profile sp ON hs.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND DATE(hs.created_at) = CURDATE()) as homeworkSubmitted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = #{classId}) as homeworkTotal, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id) FROM student_checkin sc JOIN student_profile sp ON sc.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND sc.checkin_date = CURDATE()) as checkinSubmitted, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = #{classId}) as checkinTotal

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_homework_submission hs JOIN student_profile sp ON hs.student_id = sp.id LEFT JOIN teacher_homework_feedback hf ON hs.id = hf.submission_id WHERE sp.class_id = #{classId} AND (hf.id IS NULL OR hf.status = 0)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM ai_training_plans WHERE class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) AND review_status = '待定'

SELECT id, title, content, type as notificationType, (type = 'urgent') as isImportant, 0 as readCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = CAST(tcn.class_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) as totalStudents, DATE_FORMAT(tcn.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as time FROM teacher_class_notifications tcn WHERE tcn.class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'urgent' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, tcn.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_class_notifications WHERE class_id = CAST(#{classId} AS UNSIGNED)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teacher_class_notifications (class_id, teacher_id, title, content, type, created_at) VALUES (#{classId}, #{teacherId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, type as notificationType, (type = 'urgent') as isImportant, 0 as readCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_profile WHERE class_id = CAST(tcn.class_id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci) as totalStudents, DATE_FORMAT(tcn.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as time FROM teacher_class_notifications tcn WHERE tcn.id = #{id}
